meta.name: Fedor Tsvetkov
meta.title: CHIEF MARKETING OFFICER / MARKETING DIRECTOR
meta.location: Phuket, Thailand · Open to remote & on-site opportunities
summary: Marketing executive with 8+ years scaling revenue and building MarTech infrastructure across e-commerce, health tech, and B2B. Proven track record architecting CRM/automation systems end-to-end and leading cross-functional teams to measurable growth outcomes.

bullets: Built performance marketing infrastructure from scratch; scaled monthly revenue 7x within first 18 months.
Grew inbound leads from ~2/day to ~15/day on a lean ~$2K/month ad budget.
Cut lead response time from an inconsistent ~30 min average to a sub-2-minute SLA via automation.
Established end-to-end LTV/retention infrastructure from scratch, consolidating 5+ channels into one system — enabling automated retention campaigns and promotions where none existed before.
Built go-to-market positioning and paid acquisition strategy from scratch for a new iOS/Android app; achieved CAC of $3–5 in competitive US/EU markets.
Led a cross-functional team of 5 (product/dev/growth) from go-to-market planning to public launch within ~4 months.
Managed $1M+ annual marketing budget across digital channels for a B2B agricultural machinery manufacturer.
Grew inbound lead generation from 0 to 1,000+ qualified leads/month via Google Ads, SEO, and content marketing.
Led SEO program: moved key product pages from 500+ positions to top 10 within ~12 months of sustained investment.
Drove digital expansion across 20-30+ markets (Russia, CIS, EU, Africa), coordinating with European HQ.
Built and managed structured network of 50+ dealers supporting B2B distribution.
